reason: App composition root: mounts both ToS dialog host slots (EvmToSSigner from chain-evm-kit, SolanaToSSigner from chain-solana-kit), each threaded to its own chain provider. Both-chain wiring belongs at the composition root; no chain-SDK dispatch logic here.

Thin both-chain tx-finality dispatcher: switches on ConfirmTxParams.chainKind and calls each kit's PURE finality fn (waitForTransactionReceipt from chain-evm-kit / confirm from chain-solana-kit) with read clients passed in — no SDK hooks mounted. A both-chain dispatcher can't live in either kit (the kits never import each other); app-shared is its home.
Pure-function chain-dispatch explorer-link facade: classifies once via resolveChainKind, delegates to each kit PURE url builder; dual chain-kit imports are pure fns + catalogs, no SDK hooks.
Dual catalog: ALL_KNOWN_CHAINS = SUPPORTED_EVM_CHAINS + SUPPORTED_SOLANA_CHAINS union; constants only, no SDK hooks.

Chain-dispatch facade for the chain-read-client family: classifies once via resolveChainKind and mounts both -evm/-solana leaves (Rules of Hooks), returning the active chain's clients. Dual chain-package imports name only the EVM public-client TYPE (from chain-evm-kit/transaction, type-only) and the Solana chain resolver (solanaChainFromChainId); no chain-SDK hooks mounted in the facade body.

Chain-dispatch claim hook facade: classifies once via resolveChainKind, mounts BOTH -evm/-solana arms unconditionally (Rules of Hooks), returns the active arm. Dual chain-package imports are type-only (HookContracts from airdrop-evm/contracts, Address from chain-solana-kit/config); no chain-SDK hooks/calls in the facade body.
Dual role reader / sign-out: disconnects both ecosystems (wagmi useDisconnect + chain-solana-kit useDisconnect/useSolana) unconditionally; legal multi-chain composition at the auth boundary.

Dual-chain wallet-state adapter: mounts useAccount (wagmi) + useAppKit (@reown) + useSolana unconditionally by design (portal has no single expected chain) to feed WalletControl's dual arm; composition-root infra.
